messages:
Rae (DevEx): Running into a weird onboarding blocker. Our monorepo example works locally but fails when run via Vercel Edge in dev mode with pnpm workspaces. Error during build resolve: "Package subpath './edge' is not defined by \"exports\" in /workspace/packages/sdk-js/package.json".

Rae (DevEx): Minimal repro: pnpm i at repo root, cd examples/edge-quickstart, pnpm dev (vercel) -> import { RedwoodClient } from 'sdk-js' in edge handler -> dev compile throws from rollup/esbuild. No runtime logs because it fails at bundling.

Liam: That message is classic: bundler attempted to resolve a subpath (./edge) that isn't exported. Do we intentionally import subpaths anywhere? Or do third-party tools prefer ./edge?

Rae (DevEx): We're not importing ./edge directly. My guess: Vercel's bundler resolves conditional exports and sometimes tries browser/edge fields. Our package.json currently only exposes the default entry (dist/index.mjs/cjs) and package.json. Also Typescript in the example can't see typings when installed as a workspace symlink: "Could not find a declaration file for module 'sdk-js'". NPM pack -> install tarball fixes both problems.

Sophie: Two immediate fixes on the SDK package side: (1) add explicit export for ./edge -> point to tiny ESM edge bundle (dist/edge/index.mjs), (2) add top-level "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts" so hoisted consumers get typings, (3) include "module" and "browser" fields to help older bundlers. Minimal suggested patch: 
```json
{
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js",
      "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
      "edge": "./dist/edge/index.mjs"
    },
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "module": "./dist/index.mjs",
  "browser": "./dist/index.mjs",
  "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
}
```

Liam: +1. Also note pnpm symlinks + preserved symlinks behavior differs across Node/Vite/Rollup; sometimes setting preserveSymlinks helps locally, but Vercel's pipeline won't accept that hack. The real fix is to make the package exports unambiguous.

Rae (DevEx): There's a separate but likely related runtime behavior on Edge: our auth refresh combined with automatic fetch retries caused a refresh thundering/race leading to repeated 401s. Example trace from an integration test on edge emulator: 
```
[edge] POST /predict -> 401
[edge] start refreshToken() (req A)
[edge] runtime/network auto-retry fires (req B) -> 401 -> refreshToken() (req B)
[edge] refresh A resolves and sets token, but B still retried with stale creds -> another 401
```
This loop can keep the endpoint unhealthy during onboarding testing.

Sophie: We should harden auth logic: implement a single-flight refresh so concurrent callers share the same in-flight promise and only one refresh occurs. Also ensure retries either wait for the refresh promise to resolve or are annotated to skip refresh attempts while a refresh is in progress. For safety, propagate an AbortSignal so if the original request is aborted we don't leak a pending retry.

Liam: For implementation details: maintain a module-level variable like "_refreshInFlight: Promise<string> | null" and on 401 attempt, if _refreshInFlight exists return await _refreshInFlight, otherwise start refresh and set it. Clear it on resolution/failure. Also add a short TTL to avoid repeated refreshes. Write unit tests that stub global.fetch to emit a retry and assert refresh called only once.

Rae (DevEx): For short-term onboarding docs, I'll add a troubleshooting note: pnpm workspace symlinks can cause bundlers to probe package subpaths; recommended workarounds until SDK patch: (a) npm pack + install tarball, (b) create a tiny example-local shim package that re-exports dist/index.mjs, or (c) temporarily copy the built dist into the example folder. I'll mark this as blocker for new-user edge quickstart.

BuildBot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/601 with branch fix/edge-exports-601 and bumped priority to P1 for onboarding.

Rae (DevEx): Assigning: Sophie -> PR for exports/types/module fields; Liam -> single-flight refresh + tests; I'll upload the minimal repro to the issue. Thanks :thumbsup:
